name: Dare mo Shiranai... Ushinawareta Kioku no Tobira
original_name: 誰も知らない・・・ 失われた記憶の扉
source:
A woman is running through the night forest. She seems to be pursued by someone. Man sees a strange dream that she is terrified of an attack from behind. A disaster suddenly falls on the man and his lover. And the key word is "Misty Blue".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个女人正在夜晚的森林里奔跑，似乎有人紧追在后。一名男子做了个怪梦，梦见她因担心背后遭袭而惊恐万分。一场灾难突然降临到男子和恋人身上，而解开一切的关键词是“Misty Blue”。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
